name: 5-MeO-PYR-T
summary: The drug is a tryptamine that is atypical with its potency and more. There are reports of 3mg being vapourised that caused memory loss/blackouts.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: 5-MeO-pyr-T shows very high affinity for the serotonin 5-HT1A receptor and much lower affinity or activity at other assessed serotonin receptors. At the serotonin 5-HT1A receptor, it had an affinity (Ki) of 0.577 nM and an activational potency (EC50) of 2.40 nM. These values were respectively 646-fold and 34-fold more potent than at the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor (Ki = 373 nM, EC50 = 13.5–81.3 nM (depending on assay), Emax = 92%).
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; 5-HT1A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.en: It is known mainly from laboratory studies of serotonin receptors, and has been reported as a designer drug.
uses.zh: 它主要出現在血清素受體的實驗室研究中，也曾被報告作為設計師藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它主要出现在血清素受体的实验室研究中，也曾被报告作为设计师药物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Users have reported memory loss and blackouts. Nothing reliable is known about its other risks.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。有使用者報告記憶喪失與斷片。關於它其他的風險，目前沒有可靠的資料。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。有用户报告记忆丧失与断片。关于它其他的风险，目前没有可靠的数据。

fact.en: It binds to the 5-HT1A receptor extremely tightly, more so than almost any other tryptamine, while largely ignoring the 5-HT2A receptor that classic psychedelics need.
fact.zh: 它與5-HT1A受體的結合極為緊密，幾乎勝過其他任何色胺，同時卻幾乎不理會經典迷幻藥所需的5-HT2A受體。
fact.zhHans: 它与5-HT1A受体的结合极为紧密，几乎胜过其他任何色胺，同时却几乎不理会经典迷幻药所需的5-HT2A受体。
